seoTitle: Transfer a Domain from Namecheap to GoDaddy
metaDescription: Moving your domain to GoDaddy for better management or pricing? Learn how to unlock it in Namecheap, get the EPP/Auth code, and complete the transfer.
intro: If you've registered a domain on Namecheap but want to move it to GoDaddy for management, hosting bundles, or promotional pricing, the transfer process follows a standard set of steps. This guide covers the entire process from unlocking the domain to approving the final transfer.

steps.heading: Unlock your domain in Namecheap
steps.body: Log in to Namecheap and turn off the domain lock, since it must be unlocked before any transfer request can proceed.

steps.heading: Find and copy the EPP/Auth code
steps.body: Retrieve the EPP/Auth code from your Namecheap account, which GoDaddy will require to verify you own the domain.

steps.heading: Initiate the transfer request inside GoDaddy
steps.body: Log in to GoDaddy, start a new domain transfer, and enter your domain along with the EPP/Auth code.

steps.heading: Approve the transfer via email
steps.body: Watch for a confirmation email and approve the request to allow the transfer to continue processing.

steps.heading: Track the transfer status
steps.body: Check the transfer status in GoDaddy periodically until it confirms the domain has fully moved over.

faq.question: Can I transfer a domain right after registering it?
faq.answer: No, most registrars including Namecheap require a domain to be registered for a minimum period, often 60 days, before it's eligible for transfer.

faq.question: What happens if I don't approve the transfer email in time?
faq.answer: The transfer request can expire or be delayed, so it's important to check your email and approve it promptly.

faq.question: Does transferring change my domain's expiration date?
faq.answer: Transfers commonly add a year to the registration, though this can depend on the specific registrar's transfer terms.

faq.question: Is there a cost to transfer a domain to GoDaddy?
faq.answer: Yes, transfers typically involve a fee similar to a renewal cost, though GoDaddy sometimes offers promotions on transfers.
